'''David Lankton''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Normal DPC]] on 24 February 2001 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course TIEs]], according to Yannick Lapointe's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1806">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-my-still-hurt-dpc-normald1806/ my-still-hurt-dpc-normal], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 27 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-my-still-hurt-dpc-normald1806/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
